info.name: Oath of the Last Flame
info.description: Oath of the Last Flame paladin subclass — ATÉRIOR.
info.author: Falling-Cats

description.p: A paladin who has taken Aria Emberheart's five-century sacrifice and scaled it down to something a mortal life can actually carry.

Five hundred years ago, a paladin barely into adulthood watched the sky go silent and did not run. She built a sanctuary, then a city, then a five-century climb toward a connection to the divine that refused to stay severed. She is not the Oath's founder in any formal sense. She's simply what it looks like carried all the way to its end.

This Oath doesn't ask anyone to build a tower. What it asks is smaller, and far more repeatable: pick something worth rebuilding, however modest, and give it everything. You are the last flame in a dying world. If you're fortunate, your flame will spread.

element.name: Channel Divinity: Kindle the Last Flame

p.em: 3rd-level Oath of the Last Flame feature

description.p: As a Bonus Action, expend a use of Channel Divinity to wreathe a held weapon in the Last Flame for 1 minute (or until used again). It sheds Bright Light 10 ft., Dim Light 10 ft. further.

While wreathed, hits deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 ft. until the start of your next turn. If it willingly moves away from you before then, it takes another 1d4 Radiant.

sheet.description: Wreathe a held weapon in the Last Flame for 1 minute (or until used again), shedding Bright Light 10 ft. and Dim Light 10 ft. further. Hits deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage and reduce the target's Speed by 10 ft. If it willingly moves away before your next turn, it takes another 1d4 Radiant.

p.em: 7th-level Oath of the Last Flame feature

description.p: Within your Aura of Protection, an ally who starts their turn below their hit point maximum regains hit points equal to your Charisma modifier — or gains temporary hit points equal to it, if already at maximum.

sheet.description: Within your Aura of Protection, an ally who starts their turn below their hit point maximum regains hit points equal to your Charisma modifier, or gains that much in temporary hit points if already at maximum.

p.em: 7th-level Oath of the Last Flame feature

description.p: When you take the Attack action, or use a feature or spell with a range of Touch, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to treat any point within your Aura of Protection as within your own reach.

sheet.description: When you take the Attack action, or use a feature or spell with a range of Touch, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to treat any point within your Aura of Protection as within your own reach.

p.em: 15th-level Oath of the Last Flame feature

description.p: When an ally within your Aura of Protection is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, use your Reaction: they drop to 1 hit point instead, you instantly swap positions, and they regain hit points equal to three times your Paladin level. Once per Long Rest.

sheet.description: When an ally within your Aura of Protection is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, they drop to 1 hit point instead, you instantly swap positions, and they regain hit points equal to three times your Paladin level.

p.em: 20th-level Oath of the Last Flame feature

description.p: As a Bonus Action, become an immovable conduit of divine fire for 1 minute: your Speed becomes 0, you can't take Reactions, Reach Through the Flame no longer costs Channel Divinity, and at the start of each hostile creature's turn within your Aura, it takes 2d6 Radiant damage.
Ends early if you're incapacitated, or you can end it yourself for free. Once per Long Rest.

Ends early if incapacitated or ended voluntarily.
